sections.title: Sound of letter cê
paragraphs: The letter is called (cê) /se/. Its main sound appears in (casa) /ˈka.zɐ/, which means house. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say cê
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the back of your tongue against the soft roof. Release the trapped air with no voice. For the second sound, place your tongue tip near the tooth ridge. Push air through the narrow space. Touch your throat to feel that your voice stays off for both.

sections.title: Spelling rules for cê
paragraphs: Before the vowels a, o, u or consonants, say the sound heard in (corpo) /ˈkoɾ.pu/. Before the vowels e or i, say the hissing sound heard in (cedo) /ˈse.du/ or (cidade) /si.ˈda.dɨ/.

sections.title: Comparing cê with English
paragraphs: Do not blow a puff of air when you say the first sound. Keep it clean like the sound in scan, not like car. Say the second sound like the sharp hiss in sun.
